modules.module_title: Take Charge of the Shift from Fitter Helper - Weaving

pcs.pc_description: come at least 10 - 15 minutes earlier to the work spot
ensure whether oil can, grease gun etc. is in order.
check the cleanliness of the machines & other work areas
check whether any spare/raw material/ tool / fabric/ any other material are thrown under the machines or in the other work areas
patrol around the machine to observe any abnormal sound, bring the same to the knowledge of His/Her Superior

modules.module_title: Handing over the Shift to Fitter Helper - Weaving

pcs.pc_description: report to His/ Her Superior about the quality / safety issues/ any other issue faced and should leave the department only after getting concurrence for the same from His/ Her superiors
report to his superior in case next shift reliever doesn’t report for duty. In that case hand over the shift to next shift supervisor
ensure the machines & other work area is neat & clean
